projects.title: Fast Food Delivery App
objectives: Make food discovery quick and effortless
Simplify the ordering and checkout process

overview.content: The goal of this project was to design a user-friendly, fast and trustworthy food delivery app that simplifies the ordering process while providing a delightful experience from browsing to delivery.

blocks.content: I used both qualitative and quantitative methods to understand users, their needs and frustrations.
